NeoV8 for Linux (x86-64)
========================

Uses the system's usual desktop libraries: ALSA (libasound2), OpenGL, X11/xcb and GTK 3 (file dialog). JACK is
optional. Nothing else to install.

App:     ./neov8   (ALSA by default, which also works through PipeWire; ./neov8 --backend jack for JACK;
         ./neov8 --help for every option).
         Menu entry: copy neov8.desktop to ~/.local/share/applications/ (edit its Exec= line to where neov8 is)
         and neov8.png to ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/.
Plugins: copy NeoV8.clap to ~/.clap/ and NeoV8.vst3 (the whole folder) to ~/.vst3/, then rescan in your DAW.

No sound bank is included: the instrument starts with an init bank. Load your own with LOAD BANK (SysEx .syx,
cassette recording .wav, or 8 KB battery image .bin). Your programs are kept in ~/.local/share/neov8/battery.bin
(the app) or in the DAW project (the plugin).

NeoV8 is free software (GPL-3.0-or-later): https://github.com/r0main-f/neov8
